mechanism: Both are class III antiarrhythmics with overlapping electrophysiologic effects, increasing risk of QT prolongation, bradycardia, and additive negative inotropy; amiodarone also inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing dronedarone levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor QTc interval, heart rate, and cardiac function closely with baseline and periodic ECGs and dose adjustment.
